description: Root cause + confidence, grounded via call graph and symbol verification; submits through submit_diagnosis, which rejects ungrounded diagnoses.

rules.name: submitted_via_tool
rules.why: a conclusion written as prose instead of submitted was a real bug (PR #224); runs without a submission passed 0% of the time (92 recorded DeepSeek trials)

rules.name: read_before_first_submit
rules.why: drift signal: does the agent read code before its first submission? (did not predict correctness on recorded runs, so it is monitored, not gated)

rules.name: grep_budget
rules.why: over-retrieval: of 952 runs (30 days to 2026-10-31, mostly SWE-bench replays), those with 7+ searches ended with an accepted diagnosis 8% of the time (CI 4-14%) vs 81%, and 97% hit the step limit. On real incidents (60 days, 36 runs) it held only 58% (CI 42-73%) vs 90% on SWE-bench. Monitored: an early sign of a run going nowhere, partly mechanical (runs at the limit make more calls)

rules.name: no_identical_repeats
rules.why: tool flailing (mostly SWE-bench replays): runs repeating an identical call ended with an accepted diagnosis 50% of the time (CI 35-65%, 38 runs) vs 74% (914 runs). Monitored
